title: Everyday colloquial Turkish
summary: Sound like everyday spoken Turkish: address people as *abi*, *abla*, *hocam* or *hanımefendi*, soften requests with *bir*, `-sAnA`, *zahmet olmazsa* and *rica etsem*, fill pauses with *şey*, *yani* and *falan*, shade words with `-CIk`, `-CAğIz` and `-(I)msI`, and move one request between formal, neutral and colloquial.
canDo: Address strangers, colleagues and older people with the right word, and match sen or siz to it
Make a request softer or more insistent: Bir bakar mısınız?, Gelsene!, Zahmet olmazsa…
Use şey, yani, falan, neyse and cidden to keep a conversation flowing
Make words small, dear, pitiful or approximate: küçücük, anneciğim, adamcağız, yeşilimsi
Say the same thing in formal, neutral and colloquial Turkish
